title: THE "LOW-BUDGET" CLUB JUST BROKE THE MLS POINTS RECORD
description:
77 points is now the most any MLS side has ever earned in a season.

Nashville SC passed Inter Miami's 74 from 2024. That is three extra points, and the Supporters' Shield to go with them.

They joined MLS in 2020 with a tough, low-budget label. Goalkeeper Brian Schwake and a deep defence did a lot of the work. Not glamorous. Very effective.

Now they are top seed in the East, and the playoffs start on the 22nd against Orlando or Cincinnati.

Record season done. Can Nashville go all the way and win the MLS Cup, or do the playoffs bite? Your pick below.
